comments.why: Boston Dynamics as example of practical robots.
comments.text: How is it practical? It's a beautiful design, but far simpler designs can run circles around it in every scenario I can imagine. A small version might make for a fun desk toy. When I think practical, I think Boston Dynamics. [VIDEO] [LINK]
